Family & visits

Stay close, wherever you are

Daily connection, scheduled visits, and generous family stays — because distance should never mean disconnection.

Staying connected

Internet, video calls, and daily contact

Every room has high-speed internet. Residents can make video calls with family at any time, and our team facilitates regular communication so loved ones always feel informed and involved — whether they live in France, Belgium, or further afield.

Internet in every room

Reliable connectivity for calls, messages, and sharing everyday moments with family abroad.

Video calls

Stay face-to-face with family across borders and time zones — from the comfort of your own room or terrace.

Daily visits

Family members may visit according to the activity schedule and residence guidelines. We welcome loved ones as part of daily life.

Regular updates

Consistent communication from our team on wellbeing, activities, and daily life — families are never left wondering.

Family stays

Four complimentary days, twice a year

We invite families to experience Maison Calista firsthand. Once every six months, up to four family members may stay for up to four complimentary days — sharing meals, exploring the residence, and seeing daily life for themselves.

Family stays include accommodation, meals, and return transfers from Marrakech airport — so visiting is simple, warm, and worry-free.

Additional family stay benefits vary by package: twice per year with Well-Being and Comfort, and four times per year with Signature. See our pricing page for full details.

Visit guidelines

How family visits work

Family remains at the heart of life at Maison Calista. We have designed our visit policy to balance openness with the calm rhythm of residence life.

Daily visits

Family members are welcome to visit according to the activities schedule and residence guidelines. Please coordinate with our team so visits complement — rather than disrupt — the daily rhythm.

Scheduled family stays

One family stay every six months: up to four family members, four complimentary days. Includes accommodation, meals, and return airport transfers from Marrakech.

Package benefits

Well-Being and Comfort include family stays twice per year. Signature includes family stays four times per year — our most generous welcome for visiting loved ones.

Accommodation

Comfortable guest arrangements within or near the residence, so families can share the table, explore Marrakech together, and experience our cuisine firsthand.

Included with family stays

Everything arranged for you

  • Accommodation for up to four family members
  • Full board — share meals with your loved one
  • Return transfers from Marrakech airport
  • Access to gardens, pool, and residence amenities
  • Guidance on local outings and Marrakech experiences

Many families use their first visit to explore a Discovery Stay or walk the residence before making a longer commitment. We are happy to help plan your trip.

Plan a visit or ask about family stays

We are happy to help you organise your first trip to Maison Calista — or answer questions about video calls, visit schedules, and package inclusions.
